info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Orbit API
info.description:
Allow clients to fetch precalculated Analytics through predeterministic URLs.

Contact Support:
 Name: FactSet Research Systems
 Email: api@factset.com

item.name: Returns the daily files from Open:FactSet Partner - Orbit.

query.description: Enables to get the data in ascending or descending order based on startTime. Results are in reverse chronological order if this parameter is not used.
Specifies the maximum number of results to return per result.
Specifies the starting point for pagination. This parameter is used to identify the beginning of next set of results. Using this parameter can fetch maximum of first 10000 records.
The earliest date of the Orbit file the API should fetching for based on fileTimestamp.
The latest date of the Orbit file the API should fetching for based on fileTimestamp.
The company/ticker which is associated with the transcript. Please submit a question via Issue Tracker under the Open:FactSet - Partner Communication to get the required list of tickers.
This parameter is used to filters the results based on file name.
This parameter is used to filter the results based on the headline of the transcript.
